Student registered on the Ministry of Education Noor system and first-term fees paid
documents_required: Student & parents' Iqama / National ID (Saudis: family card)

admission.notes:
Registration at The Wishing Tree Early Learning Centres is completed in two simple steps:
- Complete the registration form: by clicking the registration link available on the official website and filling in the required information.
- Pay the registration fee: amounting to SAR 2,000.Accepted age groups — children are assigned to classes based on their age at the start of the academic year, according to the following categories:
- Infants: from 6 weeks to 15 months.
- Toddlers: from 15 months to 2 years.
- Beginner Preschool: from 2 to 3 years.
- Advanced Preschool: from 3 to 4 years.
- Kindergarten: from 4 to 5 years.

- Complete the registration contract details.
- Provide a copy of the birth certificate.
